name: BN6's second wheel in the hammer's support object's spawn's r2
why: The fourth kind's spawn stores r2 at the object's +0x38 (as r3 at +0x3C): the spawner's r2 is the attack's element as the support run handed it, with BN6's Break flag ("BN6's second wheel in MegaMan's chip's attack, the Break's"). No code of the object loads its +0x38 (its block 0x080E4B88-0x080E4C3C read whole). That bit alone. bn4_chip_bighamr1 at t33
